notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: The one defining source that names it (WorldAtlas) describes only a method, combining left and right elements to reconcile them, with the Third Way as an example; the other sources found (Downes, Wikipedia-cited scholarship) describe it as vague, shifting positioning. I went through all 598 statements against these sources and critics: none is settled by them, since they state no position on any statement that the method could not hold either way.
